questions.question: Quillstone's Group PM role manages four PMs. Is that a dealbreaker?
questions.answer: Yes, when managing PMs is the core of the job. Mentoring is fine.

questions.question: Telematics devices are nice to have. Partner APIs and certification: have / partial / no?

questions.topic: Stretch review: Northwind Freight, Senior PM Freight Marketplace
